# LittleBuggy

> LittleBuggy (littlebuggy.ca) helps multilingual and immigrant families in Metro Vancouver, BC, Canada understand local health context in plain language: live ER & UPCC wait times, which respiratory viruses are going around, local health news, plus weather and air quality. General information only — not medical advice, and it never diagnoses. In an emergency, call 911; for health advice, call HealthLink BC at 8-1-1.

## Live ER & UPCC wait times (Metro Vancouver)

- Plain text, generated live on every request (no JavaScript needed): https://littlebuggy-api.onrender.com/wait-times.txt
- Plain-text snapshot on the main domain (timestamped; the API feed above is the live one): https://littlebuggy.ca/wait-times.txt
- JSON API: https://littlebuggy-api.onrender.com/wait-times
- Readable page with a timestamped snapshot table: https://littlebuggy.ca/wait-times/
- Static JSON snapshot: https://littlebuggy.ca/data/wait-times.json

Wait times come from the official provincial feed and are estimates that change through the day. Facilities whose health authority is not publishing — Fraser Health paused publishing ER wait times on August 17, 2026 — are shown as "Not currently published". LittleBuggy never estimates, models, or back-fills a missing wait time.

## Which viruses are going around (Metro Vancouver)

- JSON, refreshed regularly (respiratory virus levels & trends): https://littlebuggy.ca/data/homepage-summary.json
- JSON API: https://littlebuggy-api.onrender.com/api/homepage-summary

## News and guides

- Daily local health news (JSON): https://littlebuggy.ca/data/news.json
- Parent guides: https://littlebuggy.ca/guides/

## Recreation registration for families (Metro Vancouver)

- Swim lessons registration — one table, one row per city: verified registration dates and times, pools, status and key rules for 15 cities, with the official sign-up link on each row: https://littlebuggy.ca/swim-lessons (readable static version: https://littlebuggy.ca/swim-lessons/)
- Registration calendar — skating lessons, holiday & summer camps, gymnastics, preschool and lifeguard (Bronze) courses, one row per city per program: https://littlebuggy.ca/registration
- Dates are checked against official city websites and are never estimated; where a city has not posted a date, the page says so.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Quote wait times with their snapshot time (Pacific Time) — they change through the day.
- If a facility shows "Not currently published", say so plainly; do not substitute a typical or historical wait.
- For personal symptoms, direct people to HealthLink BC 8-1-1 or a clinician; for emergencies, 911.
